title: mris_intensity_profile
description: This program computes the intensity profile of the cortical ribbon and writes the resulting measurement into a 'curvature' file.

output_file.description: Output file where the measurement is saved.
output_file.title: Output File

write_surf.description: Write the variational pial surface target locations.
write_surf.title: Write Surf

normalize_flag.description: Normalized sampling with respect to thickness.
normalize_flag.title: Normalize Flag

mean.description: Outputs the mean profile-integral to the specified file (output is in curv format).
mean.title: Mean Profile Integral

xform.description: Specify the registration transformation that maps the T1 volume to the input volume to be sampled.
xform.title: Registration Xform

src.description: Source volume used when computing the registration transformation.
src.title: Source Volume

dst.description: Destination volume used when computing the registration transformation.
dst.title: Destination Volume
